theme: An open morning, then an afternoon train to DC.
greeting: The day is mostly yours until mid-afternoon, Dan, when the 3:16 carries you down to Washington. Two follow-ups have slipped a day and are easiest to clear before you're on the rails.

needsAttention.title: Thank-you note to Sakai-san
needsAttention.detail: In your Todoist Inbox, due yesterday — a short thank-you that's a day past and worth clearing while it's fresh.

needsAttention.title: Next steps with Shireen
needsAttention.detail: Also in your Inbox and a day overdue — a quick decision on the next move, best sent before the train.

schedule.title: Amtrak to Washington, DC
schedule.detail: Train south out of New York, ~3 hrs; eTicket is in your inbox.

flagged.title: Apple auto-renewals
flagged.detail: Todoist Pro ($59.99/yr) and Hushed ($4.99/mo) renewed today — routine, nothing to do.

flagged.title: ICGN Autumn Conference, Toronto
flagged.detail: Registration opened for the November governance conference — a networking fit for the board search.

inbox.noise: The rest is promos and newsletters — Bloomberg, Foreign Affairs, Breeze, American Airlines, quip — plus Amtrak and MTA travel receipts.
inbox.clear: No mail awaiting your reply, and nothing security- or recruiter-related.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A no-cook chilled soup for a warm DC evening — peak-August avocados and cucumbers, and nothing that asks you to face a stove after the train.

tasks.title: Look for new sconce lights for Vinalhaven bedroom

acts.line: Open and unhurried — nothing on the calendar before the train.
3:16 PM Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
